# AGSSH-STD-001 — Rule reference

**v1.5.1** · 57 rules · 9 families · cumulative profiles **Bronze ⊂ Silver ⊂ Gold**.

This is the browsable index. The full normative text — *why · check · fix · tool* for every rule —
is the [rendered standard](standard/AGSSH-STD-001-v1.5.1.pdf); the machine-readable form the runner is
tested against is [`internal/rules/manifest.yaml`](internal/rules/manifest.yaml). See the
[README](README.md) to run the gate.

**How to read.** *Obligation* — **MUST** blocks the gate, **SHOULD** is governed-waivable. *Severity* weights the score and orders the fix queue (Critical 8 · High 4 · Medium 2 · Low 1). *Profile* is the lowest cumulative tier that includes the rule (Gold ⊇ Silver ⊇ Bronze). *Levels* are the strictness bands it applies at — **L0** strict air-gap · **L1** scoped egress · **L2** marketing.

## §2 AG-NET — Egress & Air-Gap

| Rule | Requirement | Oblig. | Severity | Profile | Levels |
|------|-------------|:------:|:--------:|:------:|:------:|
| `AG-NET-01` | Self-host every runtime dependency | MUST | CRITICAL | Bronze | L0 L1 L2 |
| `AG-NET-02` | Override library default CDN loaders | MUST | CRITICAL | Bronze | L0 L1 L2 |
| `AG-NET-03` | Same-origin workers; constrain worker-src | MUST | HIGH | Silver | L0 L1 L2 |
| `AG-NET-04` | Constrain connect-src | MUST | CRITICAL | Bronze | L0 L1   (conditional · L2) |
| `AG-NET-05` | No third-party egress during load | MUST | HIGH | Silver | L0   (SHOULD · L1) |
| `AG-NET-06` | No third-party connection priming | MUST | MEDIUM | Silver | L0 L1   (SHOULD · L2) |
| `AG-NET-07` | Service Worker hygiene | MUST | HIGH | Silver | when a service worker is registered |
| `AG-NET-08` | Violation/error reporting stays same-origin | MUST | MEDIUM | Silver | L0 L1 |
| `AG-NET-09` | External _blank links sever the opener; privacy surfaces sever the referrer | MUST | MEDIUM | Bronze | L0 L1 L2 |
